datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Djibouti administrative units. The spatial data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases for four periods in 2014 (January, April, July, October), with classifications standardized according to the IPC scale.
